drafts.subject: Re: Integrating byLLM into our product - partnership?
drafts.message:
Hi Chris,

Thank you for reaching out and for your positive feedback on byLLM. We're thrilled to hear about your success with the prototype.
I’d be happy to connect you with our Partnerships Manager who can discuss deeper integration possibilities. Can we set up a call sometime next week? Please let me know your availability.

Looking forward to the conversation.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Position]
Jaseci

drafts.subject: Re: Prospective GSoC contributor - where to start?
drafts.message:
Hello Fatima,

Thank you for your interest in contributing to Jaseci and for preparing ahead of GSoC. Since you're proficient in Python and getting familiar with Jac, I recommend starting with our [Jaseci Core](https://github.com/jaseci/jaseci) repository on GitHub. You might want to look for issues labeled 'good first issue' to get started.
Feel free to reach out if you have any questions as you explore our codebase.

Happy coding!

[Your Name]
Jaseci Team

drafts.subject: Re: Bug: edge traversal returns duplicates after node delete?
drafts.message:
Hi Omar,

Thank you for bringing this issue to our attention and for providing a detailed reproduction.
This does seem like it might be an edge case that we're looking into resolving. Please go ahead and file a GitHub issue including your full snippet as it will be valuable for our debugging process.
We will get back to you soon with any temporary workarounds or fixes.

Appreciate your cooperation.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
Jaseci Team

drafts.subject: Re: Press: quote on agentic programming languages (deadline Aug 5 EOD)
drafts.message:
Hi Grace,

Thank you for reaching out for a quote. Here's our perspective:

'Agent-native programming languages are designed to naturally express the capabilities and goals of agents, offering native support for asynchronous operations and complex decision-making processes. General-purpose languages often lack these built-in features, making them less ideal for directly modeling emergent agent behaviors and interactions.'

Please let us know if there's anything else we can assist with.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
Jaseci

drafts.subject: Re: August meetup - need to move your talk to Aug 19
drafts.message:
Hi Hannah,

No worries about the change! August 19 at 6:30pm works for us, so let's plan for then.
If anything changes, feel free to reach out and we can look at September.

Thanks for organizing and see you soon!

Best,

[Your Name]
Jaseci Team
